svg.title: A relaxed detailed vector portrait
svg.desc: A detailed illustrated portrait with swept-back dark hair, half-open eyes, a small bindi, a compact smile, silver earrings and a green patterned shawl. The eyes, brows, nose, mouth, skin, hair and shawl are separate vector layers. Four expressions and tonal palette filters make this portrait editable and animatable. All artwork uses vector paths; there are no embedded photographs.
